name: table_review
method: Visual comparison of the rendered PDF region with the extracted grid (cell matching on, cache from the full run). Not blind: the reviewer's notes were received in the same message as the request.

tables.header: Year span wrong: '31 December 2025' covers c1-c5, the PDF puts c5 (Total exposure) under '31 December 2024'. Spanning header 'Risk mitigation' (c2-c4 and c6-c8 in the PDF) not detected as a cell: fused into the text of c4 and c8 only. Header rows were stored as 0 (empty-corner bug, fixed).
tables.numbers: All 24 values correct, in the right row and column.
tables.severity: high (2024 total exposure would be read as 2025)

tables.header: Two stacked tables (2025 and 2024) extracted as one 26x8 table. 9 PDF columns became 8: the empty ranking-10 column (Employee liabilities) is merged with ranking 7 (Other liabilities), so the Other-liabilities values sit under a header reading 'liabilities Employee Liabilities...'. Ranking numbers (1, 2, 3, 7, 11) fused into header text or lost ('7'); 'insolvency ranking' lost or truncated; '(most junior)' spans c2-c3 instead of c2; titles and years in header cells ('EU TLAC3: 2025'); 2025 header row not marked as header while the 2024 one is.
tables.numbers: All values correct and in the right rows; column positions consistent with rankings 1, 2, 3, 7, 11, Sum.
tables.severity: high (Other-liabilities amounts labelled as Employee liabilities; two years in one table without a year column)

comparison_with_reviewer_notes.caveat: notes were visible before the review, so this is not an independent check
